text:
Alex R: Heads up: Canary traffic for /v1/completions skewed ~3:1 in favor of variant B over the last hour. Traced to entropy seeding mismatch when client omits X-Session-ID header. Need a routing-policy fallback + quota fix. :eyes:
Priya M: Did we change the seeding algo recently?
Alex R: We switched from header-first to cookie-first hashing to reduce fragmentation, but some mobile SDKs only send the header. Router config is effectively doing `seed = cookie || header`, and when `cookie` is missing the hash function treats the seed as zero which collapses many requests into one bucket.
Samir K: Can you paste the router snippet so we can see the exact behavior?
Alex R: Sure — here's the simplified pseudo-config and hash code we ship:```yaml
route:
  split:
    - variant: A
      weight: 50
    - variant: B
      weight: 50
seed_order: [cookie, header]
```
```js
function pickBucket(seed) {
  // seed === undefined -> 0 currently
  const h = murmur32(seed);
  return h % 100;
}
```
Jordan L: Ah — `cookie || header` with an undefined cookie leads to an empty/zero seed. We should normalize and use an explicit fallback: `seed = header || cookie || request_id` (or client-ip+ua).
Priya M: Telemetry shows repeated low-entropy seeds mapping to same bucket; dashboard flagged high cache-key collisions earlier. Do we have a metric for "bucket_entropy" per-route?
Alex R: We emit `canary.bucket_entropy`, `canary.bucket_distance`, and `canary.quota_mismatch_rate` today, but only as global metrics. We need per-route + `seed_source` tag (cookie/header/uuid/ip).
Samir K: Quotas get skewed if many users collapse to the same bucket — that explains why variant B exceeded per-bucket qps and triggered fallback behavior, making observed split diverge from configured split. Suggest router guard: if effective bucket size > threshold, route to uniform sampling for that request.
Jordan L: UX issue: Console shows the configured rollout percents, not the observed traffic. Backend sampling changes make the console misrepresent what users actually hit. Console should show both "target" and "observed" splits from telemetry.
Alex R: Proposed plan:
1) Patch router hash: normalize seeds and emit `seed_source`; fallback to stable random UUID per request when no stable identifier present.
2) Emit observed_split telemetry per-route and per-variant.
3) Add alert when observed_split deviates >5% from target for 10m.
4) Prevent quota-driven auto-fallback by adding a bucket_size guard (switch to uniform sampling when detected).
5) Backfill migration for dedicated/private clusters with a compatibility flag.
Priya M: Estimate effort?
Alex R: Patch + telemetry: ~6h. Dashboard changes: ~3h. Tests + staged rollout: ~2 days.
deploy-bot: deploy started: router-config PATCH "canary-hash-fix-v2" -> staging (CI #4321)
Samir K: Also add release note for SDK teams: mobile SDK must include X-Session-ID or we will fallback to UUID; this will affect A/B continuity for some users. @Product to coordinate comms.
Jordan L: I'll add an "observed vs target" bar in the Console and a legend for `seed_source`. Ping me when the metric is live.
Alex R: I'll open PRs tonight. Action items: Alex -> router PR; Priya -> telemetry tags + alerts; Jordan -> console patch; Samir -> infra tests; Product -> notify SDK teams. :thumbsup:
